pkgmetadata.longdescription: Full Linux kernel sources for the CIX Sky1 (ARM64) SoC, combining the Gentoo genpatches set with the CIX vendor patch series (cixtech/cix-linux-main, patches-7.3 and earlier patches-7.1), local USB/PHY and PCIe hardening, and a 7.3.1 forward-port. The PCIe and Sky1 review findings and decisions are in audit/06-09; third-party patch provenance is recorded in NOTICE.md.
